post.description: Retrieves all unprocessed ('landing zone') data ingested by your Concert instance based on the search criteria. The request body must include at least one parameter by which to filter search results. This search request applies an 'AND' logic to filter inputs. The 'table of contents' is like an index of ingested data irrespective of the route in which data is brought in. It also helps facilitate backup and archive processes. Concert applies the this concept through landing zone (lz) and evidence store (el). Unprocessed data is placed in the landing zone and processed data is placed in the evidence store.

post.summary: Trigger a new evaluation. This api is used for assessments in Resilience and Infrastructure Insights Dimensions.
post.description:
- Posture name or combination of profile name, target type and target needed to identify or create a posture.
- Posture name will have precedence when both options are provided.
- Data should be in json with both key and value in double quotes.
- Timestamp should be in ISO 8601 Format. Current timestamp will be considered as default when no timezone is provided(This timestamp should not be used for production, this is provided only for testing and demo purposes).
- Examples: 
  - UTC - "2025-02-10T10:43:32.123456+00:00"
  - UTC - "2025-02-10T10:43:32.123456Z"
  - UTC - "2025-02-10T10:43:32.123456"
  - UTC - "2025-02-10T10:43:32Z"
  - IST - "2025-02-10T10:43:00.000002+05:30"
- Given name will be used as assessment name. Assessment name will remain the same even on any further update to that assessment.
- Valid assessment periods are "hour", "day", "week", "month", "quarter", "latest".
  - All the periods are based on UTC
  - hour    - one hour period from top of an hour to the end of an hour. Example: From 1PM to 2PM.
  - day     - 24-hour period starting at 12:00AM(midnight) of a day and ending at 12:00AM(midnight) of following day.
  - week    - 7-day period starting at 12:00AM(midnight) of Monday and ending at 12:00AM(midnight) of following Monday.
  - month   - 1-month period starting at 12:00AM(midnight) of 1st day of the month and ending at 12:00AM(midnight) of 1st day of following month.
  - quarter - 3-month period starting at 12:00AM(midnight) of 1st day of the January, April, July or October and ending at 12:00AM(midnight) of 1st day of first month of following quarter.
  - latest  - Entire time period from the very beginning to current time.
- There will be only one assessment within the timeframe of one period, which will be created by the first request made in that period.
- Metric input with the request is stored into the DB with timestamp.
- Latest of the values for the metrics available in the period will be used for evaluation/assessment, irrespective of data input along with the request.
- Any further requests for evaluation will update the existing assessment in the period.
- Name and assessment period will be considered only when posture or assessment is created by the first request in the period. 
- Updates to an existing assessment will not change assessment name or assessement period.
- For 'latest', each request will create a new assessment using the latest metric values available in the entire timeframe.
